name: ble_remote
title: BLE Remote
description: Touchscreen Bluetooth LE HID keyboard, mouse and gamepad for testing with BLE Input Test.
author: PAX workspace
controls: Advertise as PAX BLE Remote and connect from another P4 running BLE Input Test
Keyboard: touch keys to send USB HID key press and release reports
Mouse: drag on the pad; tap left or right click and scroll controls
Gamepad: hold the D-pad or action buttons to send HID reports
Close the app to stop advertising and release all controls
changelog: 0.1.0: first native PAPP2 BLE HID peripheral with touchscreen keyboard, mouse and gamepad controls.

native_papp2.description: Direct PAPP2 BLE HID peripheral. Uses report-reference descriptors, LE Secure Connections bonding and HID protocol mode.
